headline: ElevenLabs’ CEO on margins, IPO timing, and telling customers they’re talking to a bot
context: ElevenLabs powers the AI voice on the other end of a lot of customer service calls, and its CEO told me this week that businesses should probably tell you that — at least until getting a machine is what everyone expects anyway.
